I’d like to recommend the street lights go on the opposite end of where you stop at a 4-way intersection because for role playing, stopping at an intersection with street lights, the street light you have to pay attention to is sitting right next to you instead of on the opposite side of the intersection like how it is in real life, I would also like to recommend drift tires if possible, because drifting with newer tires is pretty tricky and can be hard to control. We need tires that can slide better on default once they are installed. Otherwise the game has a great gameplay, and maybe make fewer events where players race on the silver/nurb tracks for simpler things like coins and cash

body: The current map selection in Car Parking Multiplayer is missing critical spawn and teleport points for popular areas, specifically the Japan Suburban and Japanese Touge zones. Additionally, the game would benefit greatly from an immersive, fully functional Dynamic Weather System to enhance the realism and driving physics across all maps. Implementing these additions will improve navigation, provide fresh gameplay challenges, and highly satisfy the drifting and racing communities. Key Details & Implementation Suggestions 1. Missing Spawn Locations • Japan Suburban Spawn: Add a designated starting spawn point in the suburban town area. This should include a safe parking lot or roadside zone where players can meet up without immediately blocking traffic. • Japanese Touge Spawn: Add at least two spawn points for the mountain pass—one at the Base/Start of the mountain and one at the Summit/Apex. This allows players to instantly set up uphill or downhill drift runs without driving across the entire map first. 2. Dynamic Weather System To make the world feel alive, introduce a weather cycle selectable in single-player or controlled by room hosts in multiplayer: • Clear/Sunny: Standard lighting with optimal tire grip. • Rain/Wet: Introduces slick road surfaces, reducing tire traction for advanced drifting. body: Dear Olzhass Team,I have a few ideas that could make the truck and cargo gameplay in Car Parking Multiplayer much more engaging and realistic, while giving players new ways to spend and earn in-game currency.Advanced Mudflap Tuning:Add customizable mudflaps for trucks and long trailers (both single and double sections). Long-distance deliveries across the map should reward players with high payouts, creating a fully functional trucking career mode.Thank you for your hard work on the game! title: Hi, I have a suggestion for the car parking system
body: Hi, I have a suggestion for the car parking system. The horn and the high-beam flash are currently combined into the same button. When you press it, the horn and high beam turn on at the same time, and when you release it, both turn off. I think it would be better to separate the two functions: have a dedicated button for the horn, and a separate button for flashing the high beams (the type that turns on when you press it and turns off when you release it). This would make the controls more practical and easier to use.

title: Сделайте камеру от первого лица более реалистичной пожалуйста.
body: Хотелось бы, чтобы в режиме вождения от первого лица камера была более живой. Сейчас она ощущается слишком «каменной» и практически не передаёт движение автомобиля. Добавьте небольшую тряску, покачивания и естественную реакцию камеры на ускорение, торможение, повороты, неровности дороги и столкновения. Главное — сделать это реалистично и без перебора, чтобы во время езды появилось ощущение настоящего движения и скорости.
